recipes.title: Velveted Beef (Chinese Restaurant Tender Beef)

items.i: flank steak (or any cheap beef), sliced thin against the grain

steps: Slice the beef very thinly against the grain.
Toss with the baking soda, then add the water and massage until the beef absorbs it.
Add the sugar, chicken powder, white pepper, MSG, sesame oil, Shaoxing wine and dark soy sauce and massage everything in.
Mix in the cornstarch, then the oil, so each slice is coated. Rest for 20–30 minutes.
Sear in a very hot wok or large pan with a little oil in batches, tossing until just cooked. Use it in any stir fry.
recipes.notes: Estimated amounts and macros; the video names the ingredients without quantities. The baking soda and cornstarch coating (velveting) is what makes cheap cuts turn ultra-tender.
